svg.text: Three Horizons AI Developer Platform - Architecture Overview

g.text: Developer Experience - User-facing tools and interfaces
AI Services - Machine learning and automation capabilities
Development Tools - CI/CD pipelines and development support
Cloud Infrastructure - Azure services and compute resources
Security & Compliance - Identity, access control, and protection
🔄 End-to-End Automation: From idea to production
🔒 Security by Design: Built-in security controls
• Infrastructure as Code: All resources defined using Bicep templates and ARM deployments
• GitOps Workflow: Configuration and deployment managed through Git repositories
• Cloud Native: Kubernetes-first approach with container-based microservices
• Multi-Environment: Development, staging, and production environments with promotion workflows

svg.text: Three Horizons AI Platform Architecture v2.0
